title: Unit – 1 : Session – 7 : SLO – 1 | OOP Principles
sections: 1) Encapsulation + inheritance: class Person { private String name; public void setName(String n){ name=n; } public String getName(){ return name; } }  class Student extends Person { int roll; } — private field with public accessors = encapsulation; Student inherits Person's members = inheritance.

2) Abstraction with abstract class: abstract class Shape { abstract double area(); }  class Square extends Shape { double s; Square(double s){this.s=s;} double area(){ return s*s; } } — Shape cannot be instantiated; subclasses implement the abstract method.

3) Polymorphism via overriding: class Animal { void sound(){ System.out.println("some sound"); } }  class Dog extends Animal { @Override void sound(){ System.out.println("bark"); } }  Animal a = new Dog(); a.sound(); → prints 'bark' (run-time polymorphism).
